market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain range-bound to modestly lower over 1–3 months. RBA hawkish bias, accelerating housing falls, and iron ore softness cap upside. US tech strength and oil-price support from Iran tensions provide partial offset. Key watch: RBA commentary, CPI print, and iron ore contract pricing.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if housing stabilises and iron ore finds a floor. EV transition, AI capex cycle, and critical-mines demand offer structural growth vectors. However, construction-sector fragility and potential credit events (Bathla-type) could trigger episodic volatility. 'Bull case returns' narrative gains traction if RBA pivots by H2 2026.
